evidence_excerpts: The arrays for the DNA circuit were plotted using the output values at 24 h from the data. The ideal logic circuit behaviour corresponds to an image of a black dog with a white background for R1241, an inverted image for R1240 and their mirror images for R1101 and R1100, respectively.
text: The full rule 110-124 DNA circuit produced dual-rail fluorescence outputs at 24 hours that visually matched the intended cellular automata pattern relationships.
